prompt: Reach the blue crate at coordinates (11, 1). Choose the appropriate move according to your current position. While you are in columns 1, 2, or 3 and below row 1, reply UP. While you are in row 1, 2, or 3 and left of column 7, reply RIGHT. While you are in in columns 5, 6, or 7 and above row 7, reply DOWN. While you are in row 5, 6, or 7 and left of column 11, reply RIGHT. While you are in columns 9, 10, or 11, reply UP. Once you have reached coordinates (11, 1), reply STOP. Otherwise, reply RIGHT a couple of times and reply UP. Never reply a direction that your neighbor cells list as wall.
